release_notes_zh:
新增与修复
- 批量裁剪与导出：时间输入重做，开始与结束时间都能完整输入，不再数字乱跳
- 真实时间（墙上时间）在对话框内换算成录制内秒数，预览、文件名与写盘一致
- 通宵录制支持次日时间，也可写完整日期消除歧义
- 越界、顺序与格式错误在区间下方直接提示

改进
- 分割方式改名：录制时间 / 真实时间，每行显示时长与两种口径的换算
- 真实时间默认区间从录制表头实际起始时刻（含毫秒）起算

注意
- 安装包改为 NSIS；0.1.1 用户请先卸载旧版再安装本版本
- 命令行工具在安装目录 bin 子目录，本版本不再自动加入 PATH
release_notes_en:
New and fixed
- Batch crop dialog: time inputs no longer reformat on every keystroke, so the end time can be typed
- Real clock times are converted to recording offsets inside the dialog; preview, file names and output agree
- Overnight recordings accept next-day times, or a full date to remove the ambiguity
- Out-of-range, reversed and malformed entries are reported under each range

Improved
- Split modes renamed to Recording time / Real time, with length and cross-reference shown per range
- Real-time defaults start at the recording header time, milliseconds included

Notes
- The installer is now NSIS; uninstall 0.1.1 before installing this version
- CLI tools ship in <install dir>\bin and are no longer added to PATH automatically
